description: Japan's MLIT Sewerage Data Room links national and local indicators on service coverage, pipe maintenance, treatment, seismic measures, sludge and energy use. This resource is provided by Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, Japan. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: Unknown; no resource-specific licence established from the accessed metadata. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Tables have different reference years and definitions. It is a collection of reporting products, not one uniform time series. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
